title: RCS A01 Moog BASS — three separated notes
method: Hardware-only STFT plus Hann FFT harmonic-family peaks establish sounding C3, Eb3 and F3. Published saw and triangle are both physically −12 semitones, so played notes are MIDI60,63,65. Source-only two-ms RMS thresholds estimate separated gates. No software audio, parameter search, controller fitting or DSP edits were used.
uncertainties: All performance MIDI is reconstructed. No original note or controller events are available; the author SMF contains patch SysEx only.
Velocity 100 is a placeholder. Published filter velocity +9 and amp velocity +8 make actual velocity a timbre and gain confound.
The visible A01 label was verified by the parent at source 8 and 15 seconds, not continuously. The selected 9.25–10.07-second interior is conditional on no intervening undocumented patch change.

Played MIDI 60,63,65 is conditional on unchanged published tuning, zero master/system transpose and no pitch bend. Both upper oscillator raw coarse values −36 with WIDE off map to physical −12 semitones, not −36; tone octave is zero.

Two-ms source energy boundaries support separate notes and silence, but transport/codec delay and the shortest amp release prevent exact original MIDI gate recovery. Use roughly ±5 ms local onset/release uncertainty, plus unknown common recording alignment.

Portamento is enabled at raw time20 in SOLO mode. Earlier state before the crop is unavailable. Settled windows begin 25–33 ms after measured attacks; attacks should not be used to fit portamento or oscillator phase reset.

The published patch is dry saw+triangle with balance0, drive8, resonant LP24 cutoff39 and positive filter envelope/keyfollow. It is an independent patch-level candidate guard, not an isolated waveform/triangle measurement.
Same-take patch edits, live controls, output path/gain, mastering and lossy YouTube encoding remain unknown. No synthesis output or parameter fitting was used to select this excerpt, notes or gates.
